summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository, without committing or running any repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the escape formatter (ESC ]0; title BEL) and Control.title(title), which returns one (SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title) control code with no style; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal, returning True/False, with the required Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_console.py (set_window_title writes the sequence and returns True; skipped on win32), test_control.py (Control.title segment, no style, control list), test_windows_renderer.py (set_title called once with "Hello, world!"). Not verified: tests, Black, and mypy were not run, per instructions. A line-length scan found no new lines over 88 characters in the edited code; pre-existing long docstrings in segment.py were left unchanged.
